_comment: The website's feature cards. Each card shows only when every Store feature it covers is in the released store/listing.yaml; a released feature no card covers gets a plain card. The icon is site/feature-icons/<id>.svg, inlined at build.

cards.title: Every part on its own
cards.body: stemma splits a song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano and other, right on your PC: nothing is uploaded, and there is no account or subscription. Every model uses your graphics card when Windows supports it, and the two-stem vocal remover is quickest of all.
covers: Split any song into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other
GPU-accelerated separation on every model, with CPU fallback
Runs entirely on your PC: no account, no subscription, no uploads

cards.title: Mute your part, keep the band
cards.body: Mute the part you play and the rest of the band keeps going. Solo a stem to hear exactly what it does, and set each one's volume.
covers: Mute your part and play along with the rest of the band
Per-stem mute, solo, and volume

cards.title: Slow it down, change the key
cards.body: Play anywhere from half speed to double without the pitch dropping, or move the song up to seven semitones either way to suit your voice or tuning. Both change live while it plays.
covers: Slow down or speed up from 0.5x to 2x without changing pitch
Transpose up or down seven semitones, tempo unchanged

cards.title: Loop the hard bars
cards.body: Set A and B around the passage that trips you up and drill it. Loop Trainer starts it slow and steps the speed up on every repeat until you play it at full tempo.
covers: A-B loop to drill a difficult passage
Loop Trainer: speed steps up on every repeat until you reach full tempo

cards.title: It reads the song for you
cards.body: The key and tempo are detected for you, and a chord lane under the waveform shows the chords coming up, so you can read ahead as you play. Transpose it, and the chords follow.
covers: Automatic key and tempo detection, with a chord lane that shows the chords ahead

cards.title: Keep time with the band
cards.body: The metronome locks to the song's own beats, so it stays with a drummer who speeds up. Tap a tempo or nudge the click, and count yourself in before playback and before each loop.
covers: Beat-synced metronome with tap tempo and nudge
Count-in before playback and before each loop repeat

cards.title: Record your take
cards.body: Record yourself over the backing track, at full speed and in the original key. Each take gets its own row in the mixer: set your interface's latency once, then nudge any take into line.
covers: Record your own take over the backing track
Line up recorded takes with a latency offset and per-take nudge

cards.title: See where every part plays
cards.body: Each stem gets its own coloured lane in the waveform. Click anywhere to jump there, and the loop shades the bars you are drilling.
covers: Stacked waveform with a colored lane per stem, click-to-seek, and loop shading

cards.title: Bring a song, take your mix
cards.body: Open or drop in MP3, WAV or FLAC files, several at once, or paste a YouTube link. Export the mix you hear, a single stem, just the loop, or a whole batch of songs, as WAV or MP3.
covers: Import MP3, WAV, or FLAC files, several at once, or a YouTube link
Export your mix, a single stem, or just the loop as WAV or MP3, or several songs at once

cards.title: Ready for the lesson or the gig
cards.body: Order songs into setlists, tag them, and line up what plays next. Each song keeps its own loop, speed and pitch, and stemma reopens where you stopped.
covers: Picks up where you left off, with each song's own loop, speed, and pitch
Library with tags, setlists, a play queue, search, and shuffle

cards.title: Hands stay on the instrument
cards.body: Play, loop, mute a stem, change speed and pitch, start the metronome and jump around from the keyboard, so you can keep hold of your guitar or sticks while you practise.
covers: Keyboard shortcuts for the whole practice loop
